intro: Bihar Combined Entrance Competitive Examination Borad ( BCECEB) has Officially Released Provisional List Eligible & Not Eligible Candidates for the Post of Sr. Resident/ Tutor Phase-III Recruitment 2026 for 642 Post. Check All Details, Like Age Limit, Eligibility Details, Post Information, Pay Scale, Selection Process & More Details Related to BCECE Sr. Resident/ Tutor Jobs. Online Apply Start On April 15, 2026 & Last Date for Application is April 30, 2026. All Interested Candidates Can Download Provisional List Eligible & Not Eligible Candidates Now in the Given Link Below.

As per NMC Guidelines (Teachers Eligibility Qualifications in Medical Institutions Regulations, 2025), candidates with DNB / DNB Super Specialty are eligible for the post of Senior Resident / Tutor.
Candidates must have a Postgraduate Degree in the concerned specialty.
In case of a shortage of eligible candidates, Diploma holders in the relevant field may also be considered (with lower preference).
